artworks.title: Il parait... que mon gaillard est un grand scélérat...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a dimly lit and shadowy setting. The first figure is a man dressed in a long, dark cloak and square cap, holding a rolled-up document. He has distinct facial features and styled hair. The second figure, seen from the back, is near a large door with a face peering out from inside.

artworks.title: Vous êtes jolie...
artworks.description: The image shows two people from the waist up, gazing at each other. On the left, a woman wearing a bonnet looks at the man on the right. The woman wears a cloak or shawl and the man is older, with wavy hair and holding a book. The setting features a simple interior with blank walls and a wooden floor. A large portrait or mural is partially visible on the upper left wall.

artworks.title: Oh! quant a la vue, vous ne trouverez pas mieux qu'ici!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an attic scene with two figures present. A tall figure is balancing on a chair placed on a table, peering into a narrow attic window. The figure wears formal attire with a top hat, holding a monocle to their eye. An umbrella leans against the chair. A shorter figure in casual attire watches the first person. The artwork depicts fine lines and shading to create depth, with detailed textures visible in the walls and clothing.

artworks.title: Nourri dans le séraii...
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration showing the upper bodies of two men engaged in conversation. The man on the left is seen in profile, resting his chin on his hand with his elbow supported by his other arm. He has an elongated nose and a furrowed brow. His hair is partially visible beneath a large, round hat with a flat crown. He wears a loose-sleeved shirt. The man on the right faces the viewer more directly and has a pointed beard and bushy eyebrows, with a turban adorned with a plume on his head. He points toward himself with his right hand. His clothing is characterized by a flowing robe or shirt with long sleeves and a visible lower neckline. The background is minimal, consisting of some shaded areas to suggest dimension, and features handwritten text above and below the figures.

artworks.title: Sortez!... (Bajazet)
artworks.description: The image shows two people depicted from the waist up. The person on the left is leaning forward, possibly towards the other person, with an open mouth. They have dark hair with a turban-like headwear adorned with a feather. They are wearing a detailed garment with patterns and a sash. The person on the right is turned slightly away, with their head facing forward. They have pronounced facial features, side curls, and a lace-trimmed headdress. They are dressed in a ruffled gown. The background is off-white.

artworks.title: Va faire... admirer ta fureur...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up in a stylized drawing. The person on the left is leaning back with an arm raised slightly. This person has long, wavy hair partially falling outside a headscarf. They are wearing a light-colored short-sleeved garment with a darker shawl or wrap. The individual on the right is facing the first person with a surprised expression. This person has distinctive facial features with a prominent nose and curly hair surrounding their bald head. They are dressed in flowing, classical-style robes. Between them, the open-mouthed expression and hand gesture of the second person suggests interaction or communication. The background is a plain, textured space with handwritten annotations above and below the figures.

artworks.title: Soyez donc poli... i...
artworks.description: The image shows two caricatured figures in a full-body depiction. The person on the left, an older man, stands facing the other figure with his feet apart and hands tucked into his coat pockets. He has a large head with exaggerated facial features and wears a wide-brimmed hat. He is dressed in a long coat over a waistcoat, shirt, and cravat, and there is an object at his feet. The second person, on the right, is a younger man standing with a slightly slouched posture and his hands held together in front of him. His facial features are also exaggerated, with a long nose and sagging facial structure, and he has unkempt hair. He is dressed in a tailcoat with vertically striped trousers and is looking toward the older man. The background is plain with light shading around the figures.

artworks.title: Je n'métonne pas si les femmes ont... du goût...
artworks.description: The image shows two seated individuals and one walking away. The seated pair are on a bench, one resting their head on their hand, and the other with glasses and light-colored hair wearing a dark bonnet and dress. The other person wears a dark top hat, coat, and light pants, with a cane nearby. In the background, a person in uniform with a tall hat and cross-straps walks away down the path. Trees with lush foliage form an arching backdrop in a park or wooded area, detailed in a sketch style.

artworks.title: Alphonse Hirsch
artworks.medium: drypoint and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait focusing on the man's head and shoulders. The man is in a slightly profiled position with a three-quarter view of his face. He has sharp features, a prominent brow, closed eyes, a long nose, and a full beard covering his chin and jawline. His hair is short and somewhat tousled. The man is wearing a dark textured garment that covers his shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain and textured, emphasizing the man's face and the details of the etching.

artworks.title: At the Cafe des Ambassadeurs (Aux Ambassadeurs)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a dimly lit interior scene with figures. The artwork depicts several figures gathered intimately in a shadowy room. The use of chiaroscuro enhances the sense of depth, creating a mysterious atmosphere. Dark tones dominate the image as the figures blend into the shadows.

artworks.title: Hercules Conquering Cacus ("Ercules")
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with several figures. Two central muscular figures are engaging in combat, one with a weapon. The backdrop includes trees and a cityscape. The fine lines and shading create movement and texture, especially in the garments and scenery. The fallen figures' armor and the trees' style add to the scene's tension.

artworks.title: The Turkish Family
artworks.description: The image shows three figures from head to toe: a man, a woman, and an infant. The man on the left wears a turban and a long robe, holding the robe with his right hand while carrying a bow in his left hand. The woman, standing on the right, also wears a turban and carries the infant in her arms. She supports the child with her left arm and grips the fabric of her dress with her right hand. The woman’s clothing appears to be loose-fitting and draped around her like a robe. The infant is cradled close to her, wrapped in a small fabric. The background is plain with simple shading on the ground, and an artistic monogram 'AD' is at the bottom center of the image.

artworks.title: A Maori Woman in a Forest;  Manao Tupapau (She is Haunted by a Spirit)
artworks.description: The image depicts a surreal landscape with abstract figures. It shows a dark, woodcut-style depiction of natural elements combined with abstract human figures. A pattern of organic shapes resembling a river or body of water flows on the left side. Branches and trees stretch across the top. Abstract human-like figures are seen on the right, with one figure reclining and raising a hand to the head. The composition suggests an interaction between the natural and abstract, rendered in a monochrome palette, likely in ink or charcoal.

artworks.title: The Piper
artworks.description: The image shows a man playing the bagpipes. He wears a long coat, a hat with a wide brim, and buckle shoes. A small fluffy dog is near his feet on a leash. In the background, there is a stone wall, buildings with slanted rooftops, and a slightly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Ni asi la distingue  (Even Thus He Cannot Make Her Out)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint and drypoint on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: The image displays three individuals. Two of them are shown in full view, while the third person is partially visible. The person in the center stands upright with their body slightly turned to the side. They have delicate facial features with fine lines, long curly hair framing their face, and are dressed in a long, patterned skirt and blouse with arms crossed over their chest. To the left, a man leans forward facing the central figure with affection, has long hair tied back, wears a coat and breeches, and holds a hat. A young child peeks around his side with only their face visible. In the background, a woman is seated on a bench, wearing a dress and holding a fan. The background features intricate patterns suggesting a textured surface with shadowing for depth.

artworks.title: Ya van desplumados (There They Go Plucked)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint and drypoint on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a print depicting a group of women and fantastical animals. The four women stand together on the right, all looking towards the left. Two of them are young, with dark hair and long dresses, while the other two are old, their faces deeply wrinkled and cloth covering their heads. The two young women hold long brooms, and they seem to be sweeping away three creatures near the bottom left corner of the print. These creatures look like featherless birds, but they have the heads of men. One of the birds stands on the edge of a doorway or window on the left, through which bright light pours in. Near the top right corner, above the four women, a bird-like creature flies, its head obscured by feathers and its wings outstretched. The background is gray, aside from the bright doorway.

artworks.title: Al Conde Palatino (To the Count Palatine)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint and burin on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a figure in an intricate outfit standing over two distressed figures. The standing figure is leaning forward, administering something into one of the figures' mouths using a spoon. A table with various vessels and objects is visible in the background. The scene conveys an eerie atmosphere with exaggerated expressions and postures.

artworks.title: La filiacion (The Filiation)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures crowded together in a confined space. At the center-left, one figure is bent over holding a book. To the right, a female figure sits prominently, holding a resting man's head in her lap. In the background, more figures appear to be listening intently. One of them is gesturing with a small object. The scene is rendered in a monochrome style with intricate lines and shading.

artworks.title: View of Antwerp
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape from a distant viewpoint, displaying the skyline with buildings, church spires, and a prominent cathedral tower. The artwork features delicate and minimalistic brushstrokes with a monochromatic color palette. In the water below, boats with sails can be seen, while birds fly above the cityscape.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with figures among ruins. The image features individuals in a setting with grand decayed architectural structures, including tall and arched ceilings, collapsed elements, and intricate stonework. In the foreground, a group is gathered around an individual cradling an infant, while others observe or kneel nearby. In the background, there is a sketch of a distant town, adding depth and context to the scene. The use of line work and shading is detailed, depicting figures and the textured decay of the setting.

artworks.title: The Circumcision
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene in an interior space with arches and columns. The drawing depicts various figures interacting in a structured interior featuring large, arched architectural elements and ornate details. The room is expansive, with multiple curved arches supported by columns, leading the eye towards a vaulted ceiling in the background. The composition is carefully balanced with a central group in the foreground composed of several robed figures who appear to be interacting around a basin or table. The scene captures a mix of intricate textures from the drapery of the figures' garments to the detailed architectural lines.

artworks.title: The Presentation in the Temple
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene in a Gothic cathedral. The drawing shows a space with towering pointed arches and intricately vaulted ceilings. The background has arched windows and a gallery with small figures. The foreground includes figures in period clothing around a table. The linework captures the architectural features and attire of the characters.

artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and white ink on brown paper
artworks.description: The image shows a Cubist composition with a chair, a table, and various geometric shapes. A bottle and a glass are on the table as the main objects. The color palette is mainly brown and white, with shades of black for contrast. The chair is at the center, while the table, bottle, and glass are slightly to the left. Geometric shapes intersect and overlap throughout the scene.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: roulette and engraving over mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated, turned to the side with one arm resting on a surface while the other hand touches his chin. His detailed face with expressive eyes, nose, and lips is framed by long, wavy hair under a cap. He wears a voluminous garment, and the background is plain. The engraving identifies the artist as I. E. Liotard and notes the technique as "Effet: Clair obscur sans sacrifice."
